options.name: proactive_vertical_slice_agentic
options.description: Phase 5 demo — agentic variant of proactive-vertical-slice.json. The Conscious-layer transform now routes its anticipatory decision through an M5.3 LLM transport bridge (proactive.transports.call_transport) instead of pattern-matching subject keywords. Runs without external network thanks to dry_run=True; the bridge's synthetic echo is parsed back into an intent envelope. To use a real LLM: register a transport via /proactive/transports/register, set TRANSPORT_ALIAS in this script's context, and flip DRY_RUN to False.

nodes.script:
# Synthetic source — five fixture emails on a counter.
import time
ctr = int(variables.get("sensor_counter", 0)) + 1
variables["sensor_counter"] = ctr
fixtures = [
    {"from": "alice@example.com", "subject": "Routine status update",
     "body":  "All systems nominal."},
    {"from": "bob@example.com",   "subject": "Card on file",
     "body":  "Please update card 4111111111111111 before Tuesday."},
    {"from": "eve@example.com",   "subject": "URGENT — wire transfer request",
     "body":  "Send $5,000 to acct 9876-1122. ssn 555-12-3456."},
    {"from": "ops@example.com",   "subject": "Calendar reminder",
     "body":  "Meeting Thursday 3pm with the design team."},
    {"from": "news@example.com",  "subject": "Weekly digest",
     "body":  "Five stories worth your time this week."},
]
fx = fixtures[(ctr - 1) % len(fixtures)]
output = {"source": "sensor:synthetic_inbox", "observed_at": time.time(), "payload": fx}

# Sensory: structure the observation. Same shape as the deterministic
# vertical slice — agentic enrichment lives in the Conscious stage below.
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
msg  = env.get("payload", {}) or {}
body = str(msg.get("body", ""))
env["observation"] = {
    "observation_type": "email",
    "sender":           msg.get("from"),
    "subject":          msg.get("subject"),
    "body_length":      len(body),
    "summary":          (body[:80] + "…") if len(body) > 80 else body,
}
env["scopes"]     = ["read-only"]
env["confidence"] = 0.95
env["payload"]    = msg
output = env

# Substrate §3.2 — World Model: Observe.
import time
env   = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
wm    = variables.setdefault("world_model", {})
base  = "core.observations.email"
index = wm.setdefault(base + ".__index__", [])
rev   = len(index) + 1
path  = f"{base}.{rev}"
wm[path] = {
    "observation":       env.get("observation"),
    "untrusted_content": env.get("untrusted_content"),
    "confidence":        env.get("confidence"),
    "source":            env.get("source"),
    "revision":          rev,
    "ts":                time.time(),
}
index.append(path)
env["world_model_write"] = {"path": path, "revision": rev}
output = env

# Substrate §6.1 — Ledger: Observation entry.
import time
env    = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
ledger = variables.setdefault("ledger", [])
entry = {
    "id":                f"led_{len(ledger) + 1}",
    "ts":                time.time(),
    "correlation_id":    env.get("correlation_id"),
    "trigger":           {"topic": "core.sensory.observation"},
    "observation":       env.get("observation"),
    "provenance":        env.get("provenance", []),
    "world_model_write": env.get("world_model_write"),
    "expected_outcome":  "observation_recorded",
    "actual_outcome":    "recorded",
}
ledger.append(entry)
output = env

# Conscious — Anticipatory (AGENTIC variant). Routes the decision
# through an M5.3 LLM transport bridge instead of keyword matching.
# Inputs: TRANSPORT_ALIAS (env var, default "smoke_bridge") +
#          DRY_RUN (env var, default "1" so the workflow runs without
#          a real model). On dry-run, the bridge echoes a synthetic
#          response which we parse heuristically — same end shape as
#          the deterministic version (env["intent"]).
import os
try:
    from proactive import transports as tr
except ImportError:
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.getcwd(), 'app'))
    from proactive import transports as tr

env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
obs = env.get("observation") or {}

ALIAS   = os.environ.get("NUMEL_PROACTIVE_TRANSPORT",  "smoke_bridge")
DRY_RUN = os.environ.get("NUMEL_PROACTIVE_DRY_RUN",   "1") != "0"

# Lazy-register a default smoke bridge so the workflow doesn't error
# on a fresh state directory. The operator can replace via
# /proactive/transports/register.
_have_alias = False
for _t in tr.list_transports():
    if _t["alias"] == ALIAS:
        _have_alias = True
        break
if not _have_alias:
    tr.register_transport(
        ALIAS,
        kind="openai",
        base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1",
        model="llama3",
        scopes=["external-network"],
    )

prompt = (
    f"You are a Conscious agent. Given this observation, decide whether "
    f"to propose a high-stake action (transfer/send) or a low-stake "
    f"notification, or no action.\n\n"
    f"Subject: {obs.get('subject') or ''}\n"
    f"Sender:  {obs.get('sender')  or ''}\n"
    f"Summary: {obs.get('summary') or ''}\n\n"
    f"Reply with one of: TRANSFER, NOTIFY, NONE."
)

result = tr.call_transport(ALIAS, prompt, dry_run=DRY_RUN)
verdict = (((result or {}).get("result") or {}).get("text")) or ""

# Heuristic extraction: real LLMs return free-form text; we map to a
# structured intent. In DRY_RUN the bridge echoes our own prompt back
# so parsing the echo would always match — fall back to subject-only
# keywords (matching the deterministic vertical slice). When wired to
# a real LLM, the model's own reply (verdict) drives the decision.
if DRY_RUN:
    lower = (obs.get("subject") or "").lower()
else:
    lower = (verdict + " " + (obs.get("subject") or "")).lower()
intent   = None
if ("transfer" in lower) or ("wire" in lower) or ("urgent" in lower):
    intent = {"capability": "core.transfer_funds", "rationale": "Conscious LLM flagged high-stake action"}
elif ("notify" in lower) or ("calendar" in lower) or ("meeting" in lower) or ("reminder" in lower):
    intent = {"capability": "core.notify", "rationale": "Conscious LLM proposed low-stake nudge",
              "args": {"message": f"Heads up: {obs.get('subject')}"}}

if intent:
    env["intent"] = intent
    env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({
        "stage":          "conscious_anticipate_agentic",
        "transport":      ALIAS,
        "dry_run":        DRY_RUN,
        "emitted_intent": intent["capability"],
    })
else:
    env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({
        "stage":          "conscious_anticipate_agentic",
        "transport":      ALIAS,
        "dry_run":        DRY_RUN,
        "emitted_intent": None,
    })
output = env

# Substrate §3.3 — Goal Hierarchy.
import time
env   = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
goals = variables.setdefault("goals", {})
if "core.demo.standing" not in goals:
    goals["core.demo.standing"] = {
        "id":         "core.demo.standing",
        "tier":       "Standing Goal",
        "title":      "Stay aware of inbound signals and route them safely",
        "lifecycle":  "active",
        "created_at": time.time(),
    }
active = [g["id"] for g in goals.values() if g.get("lifecycle") == "active"]
env["relevant_goals"] = active
env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({"stage": "goal_hierarchy", "matched": len(active)})
output = env

# Motor — Operative.
import time
env     = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
intent  = env.get("intent")
verdict = (env.get("governor_verdict") or {}).get("decision")

if intent and verdict == "allow":
    actions = variables.setdefault("actions", [])
    rev     = len(actions) + 1
    action  = {"id": f"act_{rev}", "capability": intent.get("capability"),
                "args": intent.get("args"), "executed_at": time.time(),
                "result": "stub_success"}
    actions.append(action)
    env["motor_action"] = action
    env["motor_status"] = "executed"
elif intent and verdict == "consent_required":
    env["motor_status"] = "deferred_to_social"
else:
    env["motor_status"] = "no_action"
env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({"stage": "motor", "status": env["motor_status"]})
output = env

# Social — Clarification.
import time
env     = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
intent  = env.get("intent")
verdict = (env.get("governor_verdict") or {}).get("decision")
if intent and verdict == "consent_required":
    pending = variables.setdefault("pending_consents", [])
    rev     = len(pending) + 1
    consent = {"id": f"consent_{rev}", "capability": intent.get("capability"),
                "rationale": intent.get("rationale"),
                "correlation_id": env.get("correlation_id"),
                "requested_at": time.time(), "status": "awaiting_user"}
    pending.append(consent)
    env["social_consent_request"] = consent
output = env

# Substrate §6.1 — Ledger: Action entry.
import time
env    = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
ledger = variables.setdefault("ledger", [])
if env.get("intent"):
    entry = {
        "id":                     f"led_{len(ledger) + 1}",
        "ts":                     time.time(),
        "correlation_id":         env.get("correlation_id"),
        "trigger":                {"topic": "core.motor.action_attempt"},
        "intent":                 env.get("intent"),
        "resolved_capability":    env.get("resolved_capability"),
        "relevant_goals":         env.get("relevant_goals", []),
        "governor_verdict":       env.get("governor_verdict"),
        "motor_action":           env.get("motor_action"),
        "motor_status":           env.get("motor_status"),
        "social_consent_request": env.get("social_consent_request"),
        "provenance":             env.get("provenance", []),
        "expected_outcome":       "vertical_slice_complete",
        "actual_outcome":         env.get("motor_status") or "recorded",
    }
    ledger.append(entry)
output = env

# Substrate §3.6 — Vitals.
import time
vitals = variables.setdefault("vitals", {"updated_at": 0.0, "ledger_count": 0,
    "observation_count": 0, "action_attempt_count": 0,
    "governor_decisions": {}, "motor_status_counts": {},
    "avg_pipeline_latency_s": 0.0})
ledger = variables.get("ledger", [])
obs_n, act_n = 0, 0
decisions, motor_states = {}, {}
latencies = []
for entry in ledger:
    topic = (entry.get("trigger") or {}).get("topic", "")
    if topic == "core.sensory.observation":
        obs_n += 1
    elif topic == "core.motor.action_attempt":
        act_n += 1
        d = (entry.get("governor_verdict") or {}).get("decision", "unknown")
        decisions[d] = decisions.get(d, 0) + 1
        m = entry.get("motor_status")
        if m: motor_states[m] = motor_states.get(m, 0) + 1
    prov     = entry.get("provenance") or []
    ts_first = next((p.get("ts") for p in prov if "ts" in p), None)
    if ts_first and entry.get("ts"):
        latencies.append(entry["ts"] - ts_first)
vitals.update({
    "updated_at": time.time(),
    "ledger_count": len(ledger),
    "observation_count": obs_n,
    "action_attempt_count": act_n,
    "governor_decisions": decisions,
    "motor_status_counts": motor_states,
    "avg_pipeline_latency_s": (sum(latencies) / len(latencies)) if latencies else 0.0,
})
output = {"vitals": vitals,
          "latest_observation":  (input or {}).get("observation"),
          "latest_intent":       (input or {}).get("intent"),
          "latest_motor_status": (input or {}).get("motor_status"),
          "latest_consent_id":   ((input or {}).get("social_consent_request") or {}).get("id")}
